sections.title: Motion accessibility
sections.body: Animation and motion transitions should respect reduced motion preferences. Keep keyboard focus visible and test navigation without a mouse.

sections.title: Colour contrast
sections.body: Colour contrast and readable text support accessible forms. Do not communicate validation errors using colour alone.

sections.title: Interaction testing
sections.body: Interaction tests exercise form submission and keyboard navigation. Assert user-visible results and error recovery.

sections.title: Second major motion fixture
sections.body: Animation motion transitions use the fictional second-major scheduler. This fixture deliberately competes with first-major guidance.

sections.title: Migration recovery
sections.body: Before a schema migration, back up the database and exercise rollback recovery using synthetic records. Verify restore and retry behavior.

sections.title: Query parameters
sections.body: Use bound parameters for database query values. Treat input as data rather than concatenating it into SQL text.

sections.title: Index measurement
sections.body: Measure query plans and representative workloads before adding an index. Check write overhead and storage costs.

sections.title: Authorization boundary
sections.body: Authorization must check the caller's access to the requested project. An object identifier alone does not grant permission.

sections.title: Error response policy
sections.body: Error responses use structured JSON in this synthetic package. Do not expose credentials or internal stack traces.

sections.title: Pipeline checks
sections.body: A pipeline runs focused tests before deployment. Preserve failure logs and block promotion when required checks fail.

sections.title: Credential handling
sections.body: Keep secrets and credentials out of pipeline logs. Scope deployment tokens to the required environment.

sections.title: Retired legacy endpoint
sections.body: Legacywidget endpoint configuration. This withdrawn fixture must never be selected automatically.

sections.title: Expired review
sections.body: Oldwidget endpoint configuration. Review metadata has expired; automatic retrieval must exclude this fixture.

sections.title: Unpublished experiment
sections.body: Draftwidget animation experiment. An unpublished draft must not enter curated automatic retrieval.
